source.exact_source: robots/gorilla_v0_1/hardware/internal_module_research.md, A actual Victron NG imported CAD manifest
source.scope: 25.6V benchmark maxseries2; custom HV pack is new design, not four-series OEM packs

soc_window.status: design reserve incl unused SOC/headroom; not OEM allowed window or regen qualification

battery_to_bus_efficiency.status: total stored-energy to bus efficiency incl cell/internal and DC path losses; not terminal-current conversion

terminal_to_bus_DC_efficiency.status: explicit BMS/cabling/converter terminal power condition; total energy efficiency already includes this loss

pump_total_efficiency.basis: old eta_v .90.. .97 times eta_mech .85.. .90, not measured installed maps

motor_inverter_efficiency.status: task sensitivity, not source continuous certification

rotary_electromechanical_efficiency.status: positive mechanical-motion efficiency only; static hold copper loss separately required

valve_or_line_pressure_drop_MPa.status: conditional loss on commanded branch flow; return/backpressure must be real

parameters_and_status.all_motion_flow_torque_duty_inputs: assumptions to solve with same-version mass/contact/actuator J(q); no payload or gait release

two_conditional_macro_choices.description: 30min budget window: move/turn25%, grasp/environment35%, supported planning/hold40%; speeds and external loads not rated
two_conditional_macro_choices.custom_shape_scope: benchmark-equivalent volume plus0..30% geometry/insulation/cooling planning penalty, not true custom pack CAD/density guarantee; capacity and peak power both must close
two_conditional_macro_choices.current_complete_pump_pair_diagnostic: At3000rpm old2Z16 deliver59.4..64.02Lmin only under assumed efficiency; Q and motor cooling/current maps still conditional
two_conditional_macro_choices.phase_battery_delivered_power_scope: terminal-to-bus DCeta=.98; energy depletion uses totaleta=.95, not summed a second time

high_power_custom_cell_budget.reference: Molicel INR21700P45B version1.4; not a selected supplier/complete pack
high_power_custom_cell_budget.space_scope: explicit55..75% cell cylindrical-envelope packing plus20..50% package/BMS/cooling/insulation allowance; requires native layout, not guaranteed fit

conditional_power_and_energy_sized_custo.cell_current_power_scope: terminal-to-bus ηDC .98 nominal/.90.. .98 sensitivity; loaded cellV≥2.5 assumed; rated C/SOC/current/thermal maps remain open
conditional_power_and_energy_sized_custo.HV_LV_function_mass_status: explicit finite design allowance, no new module CAD/source mass guarantee
conditional_power_and_energy_sized_custo.mount_busbar_insulation_liquid_cooling_s: max(10kg,20%maxcellmass)..max(20kg,45%maxcellmass); design allowance, no supplier/design mass claim

root_selected_next_layout_integer_topolo.comparison_with_18A_design_current_ceili: loaded200V peak16.226A/cell < provisional18A, not an installed thermal rating

two_conditional_macro_choices.description: 60min sustained work question: move40%, bimanual manipulation40%, supported hold20%; not user-frozen duration/concurrency or accepted drive capability
two_conditional_macro_choices.custom_shape_scope: benchmark-equivalent volume plus0..30% geometry/insulation/cooling planning penalty, not true custom pack CAD/density guarantee; capacity and peak power both must close
two_conditional_macro_choices.current_complete_pump_pair_diagnostic: At3000rpm old2Z16 deliver59.4..64.02Lmin only under assumed efficiency; Q and motor cooling/current maps still conditional
two_conditional_macro_choices.phase_battery_delivered_power_scope: terminal-to-bus DCeta=.98; energy depletion uses totaleta=.95, not summed a second time

high_power_custom_cell_budget.reference: Molicel INR21700P45B version1.4; not a selected supplier/complete pack
high_power_custom_cell_budget.space_scope: explicit55..75% cell cylindrical-envelope packing plus20..50% package/BMS/cooling/insulation allowance; requires native layout, not guaranteed fit

conditional_power_and_energy_sized_custo.cell_current_power_scope: terminal-to-bus ηDC .98 nominal/.90.. .98 sensitivity; loaded cellV≥2.5 assumed; rated C/SOC/current/thermal maps remain open
conditional_power_and_energy_sized_custo.HV_LV_function_mass_status: explicit finite design allowance, no new module CAD/source mass guarantee
conditional_power_and_energy_sized_custo.mount_busbar_insulation_liquid_cooling_s: max(10kg,20%maxcellmass)..max(20kg,45%maxcellmass); design allowance, no supplier/design mass claim

hydraulic_hold_and_regen.reason_not_new_required_performance: old J(q)/18 topology is superseded; new gait/skills must allocate actual concurrent flow
hydraulic_hold_and_regen.local_hold_and_stop: Full actual pressure-holding/anti-cavitation/shock relief, passive brake/stop support and unload/release path required; pump shutdown assumed only when these installed functions close
hydraulic_hold_and_regen.backdrive_regen: Directional throttling normally converts negative mechanical work to oil heat; hydraulic electrical recovery needs reversible pump/motor and routing not provided. Rotor regen requires DC-link/battery SOC-current-voltage limit and dump resistor/control.

COM_and_gravity_leverage.scope: diagnostic same633 dry B rows / source COM proxies only; no new whole robot COM

formulas.terminal_power: Pbus/etaDC; etaDC is included in total stored-energy efficiency, not separately multiplied into mission_energy
formulas.pack_cell_count: ceil(max(Erequired_minWh/15.5, Pterminal_peakW/(Vloaded_min*Icell_design_max))); parallel/series integer layout not yet designed
formulas.mechanical: sum(tau_Nm*omega_rad_s)/1000; negative work separately to recovery/dump heat
formulas.conversion_heat: Pbus-Ppump_outlet-Ppositive_rotary + delta_p_valve*Q/60 + Pbus*(1/eta_battery-1); hold/aux already in Pbus; external dissipative tool work excluded

physical_unknown_red: exact pump motor controller bus cooling current match
negative power/DC-link SOC absorption/dump and emergency release
actual pack cells shape insulation HV protection C-rate and thermal
real core UA fan pressure-flow free throat duct and ambient
complete connected mounting/moving coils/support/frame net material and inertia
